sentences.text: Dactylobatus is a genus of fish belonging to the class Chondrichthyes, the family Rajidae, and the order Rajiformes.
Two species are currently recognized in the genus: Dactylobatus armatus, known as the skillet skate, and Dactylobatus clarkii, known as the hook skate.
The genus Dactylobatus was described by B. A. Bean and A. C. Weed in 1909.
The species Dactylobatus armatus was described by Bean and Weed in 1909, while Dactylobatus clarkii was described by Bigelow and Schroeder in 1958.
The type species of the genus Dactylobatus is Dactylobatus armatus.
No fossil occurrences for the genus Dactylobatus have been recorded in the Paleobiology Database.
